latest.notes:
Scheduling: songs no longer return too soon across midnight, and the rotation stops walking the same running order day after day.

• Tomorrow's log now knows what tonight is still going to play. Logs are built at 9 PM, before the 9-to-midnight airplay happens, and the scheduler was blind to it — which is why almost every early repeat landed just after midnight.
• Two records that merely share a title ("Suddenly" by Billy Ocean and by Olivia Newton-John) count as different songs now, so neither blocks the other.
• A song cut off at the top of the hour no longer counts as having aired.
• The top-of-hour filler checks separation and rest instead of always reaching for the shortest song it could find.
• Selection picks among the best-rested few rather than always the single most-rested, so identical rules stop producing identical days. Settings ▸ Scheduling ▸ Variety — set "Choose among" to "Best rested only" for the previous behaviour.
• New in Settings ▸ Scheduling: rotation-pressure notes in the log report (whether a rotation is big enough for what your clocks ask of it), and an optional recording of why each song was chosen.
• Log generation is about 5.5x faster.
• The Assistant's message box no longer freezes when a long prompt is pasted into it.
